mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'expense' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM transaction

SELECT date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'expense' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM transaction
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT t.openid, COALESCE(m.nickname, u.nickname, '') AS nickname, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN family_member m ON m.family_id = t.family_id AND m.openid = t.openid LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.openid = t.openid WHERE t.family_id = #{familyId} AND t.status = 1 AND t.date >= #{start} AND t.date <= #{end} GROUP BY t.openid, COALESCE(m.nickname, u.nickname, '') ORDER BY amount DESC
